privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.subtitle: Manage your data and account settings

exportData.title: Export Your Data
exportData.description: Download a copy of all your data stored in Minito. Note: Original task inputs are not stored for privacy - only hashed values are available.
exportData.success: Your data has been exported and is ready to share

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone. All your data will be permanently deleted.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy First:
privacyNotice.text: Your task breakdowns are saved to your account so you can pick them up on any device. Only you can see them, you can delete any of them with a long press, and all of them are removed when you delete your account. The usage analytics kept for the AI service store only a hashed value (HMAC_SHA256) of your input, never the text itself.

pause.title: Let's pause and take a breath
pause.body: What you're feeling right now is valid and important. Take a deep breath, inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, exhale for 4 seconds. Repeat this 3 times.

grounding.title: Bring your attention to your surroundings
grounding.body: Try to notice 5 things you can see, 4 things you can touch, 3 sounds you can hear, 2 things you can smell, and 1 thing you're grateful for in your current environment.

support.title: You're not alone
support.body: If you have a trusted friend, family member, or professional support line, consider reaching out to them. Asking for help when you need it is not a sign of weakness, but of strength.
